exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Application Access Token
exploitedBy.relevance: Unauthenticated API server access allows adversaries to exploit missing token validation to gain unauthorized access.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Boundary Bridging
exploitedBy.relevance: Exposed unauthenticated API endpoints enable adversaries to bridge network boundaries and access internal cluster resources.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Network Sniffing
exploitedBy.relevance: etcd exposed outside the control plane zone is vulnerable to network sniffing attacks that can intercept sensitive cluster state data.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Additional Container Cluster Roles
exploitedBy.relevance: Overpermissive ClusterRoleBindings directly correspond to attackers adding or abusing excessive container cluster roles to escalate privileges.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Temporary Elevated Cloud Access
exploitedBy.relevance: Overly broad RBAC bindings grant elevated permissions that can be exploited for privilege escalation within the cluster.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Domain or Tenant Policy Modification
exploitedBy.relevance: Missing admission webhook coverage allows adversaries to bypass policy enforcement, effectively circumventing domain-level security controls.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Execution Guardrails
exploitedBy.relevance: Gaps in admission webhook coverage remove execution guardrails that would otherwise restrict malicious workload deployment.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Steal Application Access Token
exploitedBy.relevance: Auto-mounted service account tokens across trust zones expose tokens that can be stolen from compromised pods to escalate access.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Trust Modification
exploitedBy.relevance: Propagating RBAC across tenant namespaces constitutes modification of trust relationships between isolated tenants.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Trusted Relationship
exploitedBy.relevance: Cross-namespace RBAC propagation exploits trusted relationships between namespaces to gain unauthorized access.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Conditional Access Policies
exploitedBy.relevance: A failure-open admission webhook policy allows adversaries to bypass conditional access enforcement by triggering webhook failures.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Exfiltration Over Webhook
exploitedBy.relevance: Failure-open webhook policies can be abused to deploy malicious workloads that exfiltrate data via webhook channels.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Credentials In Files
exploitedBy.relevance: Kubeconfig files contain credentials stored on disk that can be discovered and exfiltrated if not properly isolated by zone.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Cloud Accounts
exploitedBy.relevance: Kubeconfig credentials not isolated by zone can be leveraged to authenticate as valid cloud or cluster accounts from unauthorized zones.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Disable or Modify Cloud Firewall
exploitedBy.relevance: Missing network policy restrictions on control plane ingress is analogous to a missing or disabled cloud firewall allowing unrestricted access.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs
exploitedBy.relevance: Audit log gaps at the control plane boundary represent missing or incomplete logging that adversaries can exploit to operate undetected.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Disable or Modify Linux Audit System
exploitedBy.relevance: Gaps in audit logging at the control plane boundary effectively disable audit visibility, mirroring the impact of modifying the audit system.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Container and Resource Discovery
exploitedBy.relevance: Unauthenticated scheduler and controller manager endpoints allow adversaries to enumerate container resources and cluster topology.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Container CLI/API
exploitedBy.relevance: Exposed unauthenticated endpoints can be accessed via container CLI/API calls to manipulate scheduling and controller decisions.
